Text.Text: The congregation's corrupt work is ended. Let what your blade takes have a purpose beyond appetite. You've finished my Soul Ascension trials. I have no further work for you here.
The forge rite requires rank 50 in Heavy Vibroblade. Reach that rank, then return. A blade should serve its bearer before it serves a ritual.

My former congregation has turned the forge rite into an excuse to take without giving. Recover their heat ledger so I can trace the work. Defeat six Soul Ascension Adepts in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Forge Heat Ledger; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors. I'll give you the Korriban Forge Caverns Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Soul Ascension.

Here's the Korriban Forge Caverns Key. Use 'Forge Caverns' in Korriban, Sith Fortress, Forgeworks. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Soul Ascension Adepts, then return with the Soul Ascension Forge Heat Ledger.

Soul Ascension is a heavy-blade discipline that uses the strength taken in battle to sustain its bearer. My congregation learned to take and forgot what that strength was for. The rite demands restraint, because an appetite can survive long after a useful fight is over.

Mine. My voice taught them the first verse, and my exile is that they learned only the thirst. They drink without offering. No measure, no confession, no rising. Just edges that take and men who hollow. A rite practiced greedily isn't a rite anymore; it's feeding. Someone has to close their mouths, and I am done pretending it won't be by the sword.

Every heat, every quench, every blade the congregation ever fed, written in my hand and in theirs. In my liturgy, the ledger was the confession. The blade drinks, the debt is written down, and so the soul remembers what it owes. They kept writing long after they stopped confessing. I want the debt back where it can be read aloud.
Defeat six Soul Ascension Adepts in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Forge Heat Ledger; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors.
You've defeated six Soul Ascension Adepts. Let me see the Soul Ascension Forge Heat Ledger.
The tablet gives us a clear account of their teaching. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists use the tempering matrix to sustain that practice. Bring it back to me. Defeat five Soul Ascension Specialists in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Sith Tempering Matrix; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Forge Caverns. Defeat five Soul Ascension Specialists to secure the Soul Ascension Sith Tempering Matrix, then return to me.

Mine, once. I won't pretend otherwise. In my liturgy it was the cup. The steel cooled through it and learned to receive what its edge would one day drink. A cup pours both ways; that was the whole point of it. They have soldered it into a mouth that only swallows. Bring it home and I will teach it to pour again.

You've felt it by now. The strike lands, and something warm walks up your arm and closes a wound you'd stopped noticing. That is the giving-back: the blade drinks and tithes to its bearer. The congregation hoards the tithe and wonders why they starve. Drink and offer, and the soul rises. Drink and keep, and the soul just widens. There is a difference. Pray you never learn it from the inside.

Don't say 'their master' as though he arrived from somewhere else. He was my first witness. He heard every verse I ever wrote and ascended past all of them, and what he is now sits at the bottom of my confession like a stone. Ask me again when you are stronger. By then I will owe you the answer.
Defeat five Soul Ascension Specialists in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Sith Tempering Matrix; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors.
You've defeated five Soul Ascension Specialists. Let me see the Soul Ascension Sith Tempering Matrix.
The focus is out of their hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden guards the congregation's forge. Recover his anvil sigil and end that protection. Defeat the Soul Ascension Warden in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Cracked Anvil Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Forge Caverns, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Soul Ascension Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Soul Ascension Cracked Anvil Sigil.

The altar. Every rite needs one stone that does not move, and ours was the anvil. The blade drinks, the debt is written, and the oath is hammered true against that face. When he cracked it, he wasn't vandalizing. He was declaring the altar empty, and nothing owed to anyone. The sigil is his proof. Take it from him and the declaration dies.

I recommend two companions against the Soul Ascension Warden. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

He held the anvil while I spoke the consecration. Held it, you understand. Bare hands on hot iron, because he believed a rite should cost the flesh something. I loved that in him, and the thirst found it first. When you face him, he won't taunt you. He will thank you for coming. Do not let that slow your arm.

Defeat the Soul Ascension Warden in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Cracked Anvil Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Soul Ascension Warden. Let me see the Soul Ascension Cracked Anvil Sigil.
The sigil no longer backs the warden's claim. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four overseers still authorize the corrupted rite. Take their clearance token. Defeat four members of the Soul Ascension Inner Circle in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Overseer's Clearance Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Forge Caverns. Defeat four members of the Soul Ascension Inner Circle to secure the Soul Ascension Overseer's Clearance Token, then return to me.

Authority, stamped. Clearance to stand the deep floor, to sign heats, to admit and cast out. Everything a canon does, minted into a coin, because they couldn't carry the weight of the words. My liturgy issued nothing you could pocket. Bring me their token and I will show the caverns what authority without offering actually weighs.
He practiced the rite until taking became its only purpose. He still has the skill I taught him; what he's lost is the restraint. Defeating him ends the congregation's corrupted teaching.
The discipline sustains you through a fight. It doesn't decide whether the fight should continue. That judgment stays with you, and it's the part the congregation abandoned.

Defeat four members of the Soul Ascension Inner Circle in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Soul Ascension Overseer's Clearance Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors.
You've defeated four members of the Soul Ascension Inner Circle. Let me see the Soul Ascension Overseer's Clearance Token.
Their authority to teach is ended. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last voice sustaining the congregation. Defeat him in the Champion Forge and finish the rite. Defeat the Soul Ascension Master in Korriban, Champion Forge. Report back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Champion Forge, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Soul Ascension Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

I recommend two companions against the Soul Ascension Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Kneel, I think. Not to anything below. Just the ordinary kneeling of a man whose confession has finally caught up with his life. I built the rite. I chose the witness. I fled when it turned, and I sharpened you to end it. When you tell me it is done, my liturgy is done, and I will find out what an exile prays like when he is only an old man again. I confess I'm curious.

You can avoid his mistake by keeping a purpose beyond the next fight. Ask why your blade is drawn, and be willing to put it away. He stopped asking. Keep people beside you who will ask when you forget.

Defeat the Soul Ascension Master in Korriban, Champion Forge. Report back to me here in Korriban, Wasteland Interiors; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Soul Ascension Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The congregation's corrupt work is ended. Let what your blade takes have a purpose beyond appetite. You've earned the right to train Soul Ascension. Your final payment is ready.
One more question, priest.
I'll defeat six Soul Ascension Adepts.
What is Soul Ascension?
What did your congregation become?
Why does a rite need a ledger?
Your liturgy can wait for me a little longer.
Here's the Soul Ascension Forge Heat Ledger.
The verse can hold. Another question.
I'll defeat five Soul Ascension Specialists.
What was the matrix in your rite?
What does the blade give back?
And the one they call master? Confess him.
Not yet. Keep your cup a while.
Here's the Soul Ascension Sith Tempering Matrix.
Before the descent, a question.
I'll defeat the Soul Ascension Warden.
What was the anvil to the rite?
Why witnesses? Say it plainly.
You knew this warden. Tell me.
My witnesses aren't gathered yet.
Here's the Soul Ascension Cracked Anvil Sigil.
Sing me one more answer first.
I'll defeat four members of the Soul Ascension Inner Circle.
What does their token claim?
You owe me an answer. What is the master now?
What rises, when a soul rises?
Let the choir sing one day longer.
Here's the Soul Ascension Overseer's Clearance Token.
Not yet. Confess a little more.
I'll face the Soul Ascension Master and report back.
Can he be beaten at all?
And when he's gone? What's left for you?
Will I become what he became?
A last verse deserves ready witnesses. Not yet.
The Soul Ascension Master is defeated. Here's my report.
